s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive systemic illness with unintentional weight loss and fatigue, accompanied by pancytopenia and a cardiac mass
salient_findings: Months of fatigue and 20-pound unintentional weight loss
Pancytopenia with subsequent recovery of all cell lines
Cardiac mass encasing the mid-right coronary artery
key_facts: 83-year-old man
History of colon cancer treated with surgery and 5-fluorouracil
History of squamous cell carcinoma of the right palatine tonsil treated with radiation
History of squamous cell carcinoma and basal cell carcinoma of the skin
Family history of various cancers without clear genetic cause
Initial laboratory evaluation revealed new pancytopenia
Complete blood count showed pancytopenia with subsequent recovery
Peripheral blood smear showed no peripheral blasts or abnormal B or T cells
Flow cytometry of tissue blasts was positive for CD13, CD34, CD38, and CD117
Cardiac MRI showed a mass with heterogeneous signal intensity and postcontrast enhancement
Transthoracic echocardiogram showed a mass within the right atrium causing restricted anterior tricuspid leaflet motion and mild tricuspid stenosis
Endomyocardial biopsy showed 80% tissue blast cells

shortlist.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Flow cytometry of tissue blasts was positive for CD13, CD34, CD38, and CD117, and endomyocardial biopsy showed 80% tissue blast cells

shortlist.label: Cardiac Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Cardiac MRI showed a mass with heterogeneous signal intensity and postcontrast enhancement, and transthoracic echocardiogram showed a mass within the right atrium causing restricted anterior tricuspid leaflet motion and mild tricuspid stenosis

shortlist.label: Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of various cancers and presence of a cardiac mass, although lymphoma is less likely given the flow cytometry results

shortlist.label: Myeloid Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Flow cytometry of tissue blasts was positive for CD13, CD34, CD38, and CD117, and presence of a cardiac mass

shortlist.label: Metastatic Disease
shortlist.why_kept: History of multiple cancers, including colon cancer and squamous cell carcinoma, and presence of a cardiac mass

raw.rationale: The presence of tissue blast cells positive for CD13, CD34, CD38, and CD117, along with a mass in the right atrium and pancytopenia, suggests a myeloid neoplasm. The endomyocardial biopsy showing 80% tissue blast cells further supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
rejected.why: While the flow cytometry results could suggest AML, the presence of a discrete mass in the heart and the specific immunophenotype suggest a localized myeloid sarcoma rather than a systemic leukemia.

rejected.label: Cardiac Sarcoma
rejected.why: The immunophenotype of the blast cells is more consistent with a myeloid neoplasm than a sarcoma.

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: The flow cytometry results do not support a lymphoid neoplasm.

rejected.label: Metastatic Disease
rejected.why: The patient's history of cancer does not clearly explain the current presentation, and the immunophenotype of the blast cells suggests a primary myeloid neoplasm.
